generalfeedback: In order to solve this problem we will have to use the quotient rule calc_quotient_rule as follows: \[\begin{array}{rcl}\displaystyle \frac{d}{d{{CT:0}}}\left[{{CT:1}}\right] &\displaystyle =&\displaystyle \frac{\left[\frac{d}{d{{CT:0}}}({{CT:2}})\right]\cdot {{CT:3}} - {{CT:2}}\cdot \left[\frac{d}{d{{CT:0}}}[{{CT:3}}]\right]}{[{{CT:3}}]^2} \\ &\displaystyle =&\displaystyle \frac{[{{CT:4}}]\cdot {{CT:3}} - {{CT:2}}\cdot [{{CT:5}}]}{{CT:6}} \\ &\displaystyle =&\displaystyle \frac{{{CT:7}} - {{CT:8}}}{{CT:6}} \end{array}\]

on_true.feedback: To differentiate a quotient use the rule \[\frac{d}{dx}\left[\frac{f}{g}\right] = \frac{\frac{df}{dx}g-f\frac{dg}{dx}}{g^2}.\] You cannot get the derivative of a quotient by dividing the derivatives.

You appear to have applied the quotient rule incorrectly. It is \[\frac{d}{dx}\left[\frac{f}{g}\right] = \frac{\frac{df}{dx}g-f\frac{dg}{dx}}{g^2}.\] It appears that you divided by \(f^2\), not \(g^2\).

You appear to have applied the quotient rule incorrectly. It is \[\frac{d}{dx}\left[\frac{f}{g}\right] = \frac{\frac{df}{dx}g-f\frac{dg}{dx}}{g^2}.\] You used \[\frac{\frac{df}{dx}g-f\frac{dg}{dx}}{g}.\]

You appear to have applied the quotient rule incorrectly. It is \[\frac{d}{dx}\left[\frac{f}{g}\right] = \frac{\frac{df}{dx}g-f\frac{dg}{dx}}{g^2}.\] You used \[\frac{\frac{df}{dx}g+f\frac{dg}{dx}}{g^2}.\]
